notes: The Egnyte Domain Picker asks the user to 'Enter the domain name associated with your Egnyte Account' in a field with a 'yourdomain.egnyte.com' placeholder. A 'Find my domain' link helps users who don't know it, and a purple Continue button proceeds. A white card with the Egnyte logo sits on a pale gradient with a teal top bar and a footer with legal links, plus a 'Start Free Trial' link. No sign-in method, requesting app name or permissions are shown yet.
